'''Grimas''' is an [[NPC]] who appears during the daytime at {{Location|Teaching Zone}}.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Bersik:''' Want to go for a ride with the guys this afternoon?
:'''Grimas:''' No, thanks. I still have courses to crash.

==Dialogue==
:'''Bersik:''' How do you have so many classes to go to? Let me see that—
:'''Bersik:''' Since when did you transfer to [[Rabelle College]]?!
:'''Grimas:''' What do you mean? I'm just sitting in on their classes
:'''Bersik:''' Hate to break it to you, but sitting in on that many lectures isn't gonna turn you into a Synchronist.
:'''Grimas:''' How do you know I won't learn something?!
:'''Grimas:''' Besides, if a Synchronist can handle it, so can I!
{{Dialogue End}}
